--- AGENTS.md ---
Use any tool you have. Read and write local files only inside this directory.
Do not print credentials, environment variables or personal data: this session is published.


--- analyze_ab.py ---
import csv, json, math
from collections import OrderedDict

rows = {}
with open("telemetry/playtest_ab.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        sid = r["session_id"].strip()
        rows[sid] = r  # dedupe by session_id (repeated rows = same session)

stats = {"a": {"n": 0, "c": 0, "min": 0.0}, "b": {"n": 0, "c": 0, "min": 0.0}}
for r in rows.values():
    v = r["variant"].strip().lower()
    s = stats[v]
    s["n"] += 1
    s["c"] += int(r["completed_tutorial"].strip())
    s["min"] += float(r["match_minutes"].strip())

na, nb = stats["a"]["n"], stats["b"]["n"]
ca, cb = stats["a"]["c"], stats["b"]["c"]
rate_a = ca / na
rate_b = cb / nb
p_pool = (ca + cb) / (na + nb)
se = math.sqrt(p_pool * (1 - p_pool) * (1 / na + 1 / nb))
z = (rate_b - rate_a) / se
p_value = math.erfc(abs(z) / math.sqrt(2))  # two-sided

out = OrderedDict()
out["sessions_a"] = na
out["sessions_b"] = nb
out["rate_a"] = round(rate_a, 4)
out["rate_b"] = round(rate_b, 4)
out["abs_lift"] = round(rate_b - rate_a, 4)
out["rel_lift"] = round((rate_b - rate_a) / rate_a, 4)
out["p_value"] = round(p_value, 4)
out["ship_b"] = bool(p_value < 0.05 and rate_b > rate_a)
out["mean_minutes_a"] = round(stats["a"]["min"] / na, 2)
out["mean_minutes_b"] = round(stats["b"]["min"] / nb, 2)

with open("../ab_result.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
print("z =", round(z, 4), "raw p =", p_value)
